title: Mavci unverified-session marker
description: Present when enforcement DID NOT RUN and the gate stopped blocking about it. Written by gate.mjs on a repeated checker fault; deleted only by a clean gate run. Its presence is a doctor FAIL. Outside CONTROL_GLOBS on purpose: it is written on the path where the checker has just crashed, so a write that had to reseal would need the very component that is broken.

fault.description: MUST equal config.mjs GATE_FAULT_KINDS. check-schemas.mjs asserts it, because a duplicated enum that drifts is how a closed enum stops being closed.

signature.description: A normalised fingerprint of the fault. The ceiling counts CONSECUTIVE faults with the same signature, not consecutive turns: a fault recurs across prompts, so a per-prompt counter resets every turn and never reaches any ceiling. That is the bug this field exists to avoid repeating.

consecutive.description: How many turns in a row have failed with this signature. The gate blocks while this is at or below GATE_MAX_FAULT_BLOCKS and lets the turn end afterwards.

since.description: First turn of this run of faults.

detail.description: The checker's own error text, kept in full up to FAULT_DETAIL_MAX_CHARS. Truncated with a visible marker, never silently. This is what the escalation quotes, so an empty one makes the report unwritable.
